task: Owner Invoice Number field READ-ONLY in live UAT — role hydration race
verdict: ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED · FIX APPLIED · LIVE UI VERIFIED
root_cause: AuthContext.readCachedUser() hydrates the user state SYNCHRONOUSLY from localStorage on mount. AuthCallback caches the /auth/session response, which returns {user_id, email, name, picture, session_token} — with NO role field. GET /auth/me (which now returns role/effective_role/is_staff) fires asynchronously and eventually overwrites the cache. The FIRST render of /invoices/new therefore had `user.effective_role === undefined` and the previous strict `... === 'owner'` check flipped isOwner to FALSE, disabling the field until /auth/me landed. Users saw a disabled field with the 'Owner-only override' hint even though they were the Owner.

frontend_only: Replaced `isOwner = ((user?.effective_role || user?.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'owner')` with a PERMISSIVE-default derivation:

Unknown / empty role now renders the field as Owner-editable (backend authorization remains the final gate). Only an explicitly present, non-'owner' role disables the field. Trim + lowercase absorbs padding / casing weirdness on the wire.
